title: DojoLiq Cool Menthol 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid by Vaporesso
description: Vaporesso DojoLiq Cool Menthol is the ultimate choice for a brisk and invigorating vape. The profile is clean and straightforward, featuring a sharp and frosty Menthol inhale that instantly awakens the senses. The icy cooling sensation carries through to the exhale, leaving the palate feeling fresh and deeply satisfied without any distracting fruity or sweet undertones. Formulated with a bespoke 45% VG / 55% PG ratio tailored specifically to this flavour, this Nicotine Salt e-liquid is crafted to provide exceptional clarity and a smooth throat hit. This fine-tuned blend performs flawlessly with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) refillable pod kits and starter devices, ensuring sharp flavour transmission. Brought to you by the hardware specialists at Vaporesso, the DojoLiq collection captures the vibrant, authentic flavours of their popular Dojo series in a versatile 10ml format. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, these e-liquids offer rapid nicotine satisfaction and consistently bold taste from the first drop to the last.
